description: Add home gallery tables; business ordering uses existing fields and youth model access changes no database columns. Preserve the existing dev/-1 Payload migration baseline.
statements:
CREATE TABLE `home_gallery_photos` (
    `_order` integer NOT NULL,
    `_parent_id` integer NOT NULL,
    `id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    `image_id` integer NOT NULL,
    `alt` text,
    FOREIGN KEY (`image_id`) REFERENCES `media`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE set null,
    FOREIGN KEY (`_parent_id`) REFERENCES `home_gallery`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
  );
